newsitem.title: UK: UK announces Thames Trains franchise preferred bid.
newsitem.headline: UK announces Thames Trains franchise preferred bid.

text.p: The director of the UK's office of passenger rail franchising (OPRAF) said on Monday that he had selected Victoria Railways, a joint venture between Go-Ahead Group and Thames Trains Limited, as preferred bidder for the Thames Trains Ltd regional franchise.
"A formal award announcement giving further details of the deal is expected to be made soon," Roger Salmon said in a statement.
UK urban bus operator Go-Ahead, which is the 65 percent majority partner in Victory, said it was pleased to have been selected along with the management team of Thames Trains.
"The company is uniquely positioned to benefit from the planned developments in West London, Heathrow, the Thames Valley and Oxfordshire," Go-Ahead said in a statement.

Go-Ahead's managing director Martin Ballinger said the company was bidding for further rail franchises and had been shortlisted for the Docklands Light Railway service, in London's Docklands area, with France's VIA-GTI.
